name: Illhveli, Sverðhvalur
body:
SVERÐHVALUR
CR 12

This sleek mottled brown whale has wide forward-facing eyes above a tooth-filled beak-like maw. A towering razor-edged dorsal blade juts up from its back.

XP 19,200
NE Gargantuan outsider (aquatic, evil, illhveli, native)
Init +5; Senses blindsight 120 ft. (underwater only), darkvision 60 ft., true seeing; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 7, flat-footed 26 (+1 Dex, +20 natural, –4 size)
hp 162 (13d10+91)
Fort +13, Ref +11, Will +11
DR 10/good; Immune cold, pressure damage from deep water; Resist electricity 10, sonic 10; SR 23

OFFENSE

Speed swim 50 ft.
Melee bite +21 (4d6+18) or gore +21 (4d6+18)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft. (20 ft. with gore)
Special Attacks capsize, churn water, ship breaker
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th; concentration +15)

Constant—true seeing
3/day—dispel magic, fear (DC 17), unholy blight (DC 17)
1/day—blasphemy (DC 20)

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 13, Con 24, Int 9, Wis 13, Cha 16
Base Atk +13; CMB +29; CMD 40
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Intimidate +19, Perception +17, Stealth +5, Survival +17, Swim +36
Languages Aquan, Common (can’t speak)
SQ amphibious

ECOLOGY

Environment cold and temperate oceans
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental
